sample_unit: FDA-authorized AI/ML-enabled medical devices with PCCPs

links.outcome: Subgroup analyses reported in preapproval testing of devices with PCCPs
links.effect: Subgroup analyses were reported for only eleven of 26 devices, and none included patient outcomes data.
links.quote: Subgroup analyses were reported for eleven devices and none included patient outcomes data.

links.outcome: Prospective evaluation and patient outcomes evidence before authorization
links.effect: Only seven of 26 devices were prospectively evaluated; no subgroup analyses included patient outcomes data.
links.quote: Preapproval testing was limited with seven devices prospectively evaluated and thirteen undergoing human factors testing.

links.outcome: Availability and content of user manuals and labeling for PCCP devices
links.effect: User manuals identifiable online for 54% of devices; many lacked performance details or mentioned PCCPs.
links.quote: User manuals could be identified online for 54% of devices, though many lacked performance details or mentioned PCCPs.

screen.reason: Empirical cross-sectional characterization of FDA-authorized Predetermined Change Control Plans (PCCPs) for AI/ML medical devices; does not test a specific deployment intervention with a comparison.
